package.description: A native, lightweight, no-Docker local development environment for web & WordPress developers.

en-US.description: A native, lightweight, no-Docker local development environment for web & WordPress developers.
en-US.longDescription: rexenv runs the whole local stack — edge proxy with auto-HTTPS, shared web server, multi-version PHP, MySQL/PostgreSQL, one-click WordPress, .rex DNS, mail catching, tunnels — from one window, with native binaries and no Docker.
en-US.name: rexenv
